name: Tales of the Sword in Stone
source:
See through the perspective of a powerful sword in stone. Choosing which heroes you deem worthy to support and which ones to turn down.

[From [url=https://tinkering-tail-games.itch.io/tales-of-the-sword-in-stone]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
透过一把威力强大的石中剑的视角看待世事：亲自挑选哪些英雄配得上你的扶持，又有哪些人应当被果断拒绝。

[摘自[url=https://tinkering-tail-games.itch.io/tales-of-the-sword-in-stone]itch.io[/url]]
